['DMG Mori AG '].company_description: DMG Mori AG operates as one of Germany's largest manufacturers of cutting machine tools and a manufacturer of CNC-controlled lathes and milling machines. The company's products include machines, industrial services, software, and energy solutions. It is based in Bielefeld and is a part of the SDAX technology group, with 21 production sites worldwide and 161 international sales and service sites.

['Hermes Europe GmbH '].company_description: Hermes Europe GmbH is a German delivery company headquartered in Hamburg, owned by the retail company Otto GmbH. It primarily operates in the delivery and logistics sector.
